name: Depth Runners (The Undercity Circuit)
description: Depth Runners are organized teams of urban explorers mapping and cataloguing the sealed sub-infrastructure of Old Chicago — flooded transit tunnels, pre-Consolidation bunker networks, the ruins of neighborhoods demolished to build the Shelf's lowest foundations. The Circuit is their informal competitive circuit: teams race to document and geo-tag new locations first, uploading encrypted proof-of-presence files to a shared Underworld repository called the Cartography of What Was. The most celebrated run in Circuit history was the 2221 breach of Sealed Zone Theta-9, a flooded district office complex containing intact administrative records from 2089-2103.
cultural_impact: The Cartography of What Was has become an unexpected historical archive, with academic institutions and activist groups mining it for evidence of pre-Corponation property rights and community displacement records. Corporate security forces have begun actively patrolling known entry points, turning exploration into a higher-stakes endeavor.
key_figures: Yusuf Okonkwo-Vasquez (veteran runner, lost two fingers to a structural collapse in Theta-9, still active)
PRISM (E.L.F. who maintains and curates the Cartography repository)
Sera Halvorsen-Chittibabu (youngest Circuit record-holder, age 19, four new zones documented)
locations: Entry Node 'The Throat' — a collapsed parking structure in Shelf Sector 3
Sealed Zone Theta-9, flooded sub-level, coordinates restricted
The Cartography of What Was (Underworld repository, no fixed address)
story_hooks: A Depth Runner team discovers a sealed room in Old Chicago containing a functional server cluster still running — and still connected to something.
The Cartography repository contains records that prove a corponation's founding land acquisition was fraudulent; the E.L.F. PRISM is being hunted, and the runners who uploaded the evidence are next.
A new sealed zone has been discovered that doesn't appear on any historical map — it was built after the Consolidation, not before, and someone very powerful wants it to stay lost.
